items.name: v14_seg1
items.text: [worried] Ertaga taqdimotmi? Hali bitta slayd ham yo'qmi?

items.name: v14_seg2
items.text: [confident] Slayd Ol botiga faqat mavzuni yozing.

items.name: v14_seg3
items.text: [enthusiastic] Rasmli, rejali, chiroyli taqdimot! PowerPoint va PDF'da — tayyor!

items.name: v14_seg4
items.text: [excited] Telegramda Slayd Ol! Hoziroq sinab ko'ring!
